title: lithocarpus elegans var. collettii
intro: Lithocarpus elegans var. collettii, commonly known as Collett's tanbark oak, is a plant species within the family Fagaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Collett's tanbark oak include wound healing, pain relief, and the treatment of various infectious diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
